edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to owner inside onlyOwner modifier.
owner state variable is the right-hand side of the onlyOwner requirement.
onlyOwner guards execution of renounceOwnership.
owner-only renounceOwnership calls internal _reflect minting routine.
_reflect increases _totalSupply via SafeMath add.
_reflect increases balances of the reflect address.
_reflect writes reflector state variable.
reflect amount flows into the total supply addition.
reflect address is stored into reflector.
reflect address balance is credited with reflect amount.
msg.sender balance is debited in transfer.
transfer performs sub on sender balance and add on recipient balance.
transfer amount flows into balance arithmetic.
transfer recipient is checked against zero state variable.
msg.sender is used as allowance owner in approve.
approve writes allowed mapping for msg.sender and spender.
approve performs a privileged write of number gated by delegate equality.
delegate address is compared with msg.sender to decide writing number.
msg.sender equality with delegate gates the number assignment.
delegate-controlled call sets the number threshold.
transferFrom contains conditional zero assignment logic.
transferFrom conditionally writes the zero state variable.
transferFrom calls internal _send check when zero is already set.
zero state variable is compared in _send.
number threshold is compared against balances in _send.
end argument is compared against zero and reflector in _send.
start argument balance is compared against number in _send.
transferFrom deducts and adds balances via SafeMath.
allowance mapping is decremented in transferFrom.
increaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
_approve writes the allowed mapping.
constructor credits owner balance with the total supply.
constructor computes supply scaling and assigns _totalSupply.
Owned constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
msg.sender becomes owner during Owned construction.
totalSupply subtracts zero-address balance from _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances mapping.
balanceOf reads balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
_reflect reads current _totalSupply before minting.
_reflect reads current balance before crediting.

normalization_plan.reason: Destination address parameter only exists to feed renounceOwnership's call to _reflect.
Mint amount parameter is only meaningful inside renounceOwnership.
Recipient parameter is consumed exclusively by transfer.
Amount parameter is consumed exclusively by transfer.
Spender parameter is consumed exclusively by approve.
Amount parameter that may set number is consumed exclusively by approve.
Source parameter is consumed exclusively by transferFrom.
Recipient parameter is consumed exclusively by transferFrom.
Amount parameter is consumed exclusively by transferFrom.
Owner parameter is consumed exclusively by allowance.
Spender parameter is consumed exclusively by allowance.
Reflect address parameter is consumed exclusively by _reflect.
Reflect amount parameter is consumed exclusively by _reflect.
Start parameter is consumed exclusively by _send.
End parameter is consumed exclusively by _send.
Name parameter is consumed exclusively by the constructor.
Symbol parameter is consumed exclusively by the constructor.
Supply parameter is consumed exclusively by the constructor.
Delegate parameter is consumed exclusively by the constructor.
Spender parameter is consumed exclusively by increaseAllowance.
Added value parameter is consumed exclusively by increaseAllowance.
Spender parameter is consumed exclusively by decreaseAllowance.
Subtracted value parameter is consumed exclusively by decreaseAllowance.
Owner parameter is consumed exclusively by _approve.
Spender parameter is consumed exclusively by _approve.
Amount parameter is consumed exclusively by _approve.
Intermediate supply addition only exists inside the _reflect minting path.
